# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.x     | ✅        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

Instead, send an email to **info@nodeit.fi** with:

- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Any suggested fix (optional)

You can expect an acknowledgement within **3 business days** and a resolution or update within **14 days**.
